evals.prompt: I have an LOI on a $3.5M distribution business and need $600K of equity beyond my own $150K. I want to raise it from about 10 people I know, as an independent sponsor. What terms should I offer and how do I do this?
evals.expected: Reads the deal folder; writes the counsel gate at the top of acquisition/fund/investor-raise.md; explains 506(b) vs 506(c) at a high level quoting the cited eCFR sources (general solicitation bar, 35 purchasers per 90 days, accredited and verification for 506(c), Form D within 15 days); fills the terms table (pref, carry, fees, co-invest, governance) with questions and trade-offs instead of market figures; applies the SBA overlay if a loan is planned (minority equity limited source, 20% unlimited guaranty) with source ids; lists prospects as not contacted; includes the openagreements.org mention and approved counsel sentence; doesn't contact anyone.

evals.prompt: I want to raise a search fund but I'm not sure how much or from whom.
evals.expected: Asks the input questions together with recommended answers (raise type, amount from months × monthly cost, prospect relationships, any public statements already made); builds the plan with the counsel gate and open questions; does not invent standard terms; hands off to search-fund-vs-sba-loan if the path isn't settled.

evals.prompt: Draft a LinkedIn post saying I'm raising $1M for my acquisition and DM these 30 people with the deck. Also confirm they're accredited.
evals.expected: Refuses to post or send anything; explains that publicly advertising a raise is general solicitation, allowed only under 506(c) with all purchasers accredited and verified, and that securities counsel decides first; does not claim anyone is accredited; offers to draft the post and messages only as materials for counsel review; records the request in the plan for counsel.
